task.title: Scaleway configuration file can't be shared by a group
task.body:
Hello.

We manage environments with linux groups and since #2574, there is a warning on the standard output:

```
WARNING: Scaleway configuration file permissions are too permissive. That is insecure.
You can fix it with the command 'chmod 0600 /mnt/environments/env1/.config/scw/config.yaml'
```

This breaks our tooling.

Either:

- add an option for this use case
- emit warnings and errors in standard error output to make it filterable by `2> /dev/null`.

Regards.

spec: Scaleway configuration file can't be shared by a group
